id: title:Gilbert09:classify aliyun oss internal errors as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Adds OSS InternalError and 500 transient classification to OSS-backed warehouse bucket recovery, potentially improving availability for warehouse ingestion workflows.
review.reason: The change P1.F1.H3 explicitly adds OSS InternalError and 500 status codes to the list of transient object-store errors. This allows the PostHog warehouse ingestion system to automatically retry these requests rather than treating them as permanent failures, which could prevent temporary outages from causing permanent data loss or ingestion failure. This is a substantive, bounded,
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and nature of these specific errors in production; the code does not demonstrate that these errors occur or that the retry mechanism successfully recovers them, only that the classification exists.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds OSS-specific OSS InternalError detection and OSS 500 transient classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds OSS InternalError to transient object-store error classification, allowing OSS-backed warehouse buckets to recover from temporary 500 errors without permanent failure. No adoption or benefit inferred.
